messages:
Olivia Chen: hey folks, first-day onboarding hiccup — I followed the kubeconfig instructions but when I try to list pods in the `dev` namespace I get Forbidden. Not sure if I need a service account or a group added. can someone point me to the quickest fix? /cc @DevEx

DevEx: welcome! can you paste the exact error and the output of `kubectl config current-context`? also which OS you’re on?

Olivia Chen: current-context is `redwood-dev`. macOS Sonoma. error: 
```
Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "user:olivia@redwood.com" cannot list resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "dev"
```
I tried `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=dev` -> "no"

DevEx: ok two common paths: (1) you're missing the org SSO group binding for team-dev OR (2) you need to switch to the onboarding service account we create for scripted tasks. which flow are you following from the onboarding doc?

Olivia Chen: I followed the quickstart which mentioned the onboarding service account for CI steps, but I thought day-1 ad-hoc work uses my SSO identity. happy to be added to team-dev if that's the normal flow.

Samir Patel: @Olivia Chen usually we add new hires to the `team-dev` OIDC group during account setup. can you check Okta -> Groups and confirm you're a member of `redwood:team-dev`? if not, ping peopleops or file the access request form: https://intra.redwood/it/onboard-access (select Kubernetes -> dev namespace).

Olivia Chen: I don't see `redwood:team-dev` in my Okta groups. filed the form just now (ticket 5932).

InfraOps: looping in infra. @Samir Patel / @DevEx — if you prefer a temporary workaround we can grant a one-off rolebinding so Olivia can continue. otherwise we'll wait for the group sync.

DevEx: workaround steps if you need immediate access (infra must apply): create a RoleBinding in `dev` that binds `olivia@redwood.com` to the `dev-developer` role. example: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: onboarding-olivia-temp
  namespace: dev
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "user:olivia@redwood.com"
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: dev-developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
This is temporary until the SSO group is synced.

InfraOps: applied a temporary binding and created a note to remove it after group sync. try again @Olivia Chen.

Onboard Bot: automated note: access request 5932 status updated -> infra temp-binding applied.

Olivia Chen: confirmed — `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=dev` now returns "yes" and `kubectl get pods -n dev` lists stuff. thanks! :tada:

Samir Patel: awesome — I'll follow up with People Ops to ensure you get the `redwood:team-dev` group so we can remove the temp binding.

Olivia Chen: perfect, thanks everyone. calling out that adding the example RoleBinding to the onboarding doc would have helped me spot this earlier :slightly_smiling_face:

DevEx: good feedback, will add a short troubleshooting snippet to the quickstart (link to PR when live). :thumbsup:
